messages:
maria_cs: Chloe from Acme (chloe_acme) flagged latency 95p ~700ms on hosted API during batch tests. Onboarding mostly done but renewal in 30 days — high risk unless we cut cost/latency. Any quick ops recs? :eyes:

devin_se: Can you paste a sample request payload, batch size, seq len, and model id? Also confirm hosted vs dedicated so we can recommend routing/queue knobs.

chloe_acme: Hosted. Model: rdm-xlarge-v1. Typical seq=256, bursts with batch=16. Logs uploaded to s3://acme-logs/reports/178123. Renewal review scheduled 2026-04-15.

ashwin_ml: Quick prioritized suggestions: 1) Quantize rdm-xlarge-v1 to int8 (per-layer, AWQ/LLM-int8) and validate quality; 2) Canary swap to rdm-large-v1 during peaks with policy-based routing; 3) Enable prefix/KV caching for repeated prompt prefixes. Expect ~25-45% latency improvement depending on token mix.

ashwin_ml: Example quant command we use in infra sandbox:
```
python tools/quantize.py --model rdm-xlarge-v1 --scheme awq --bits 8 --calib 256 --out rdm-xlarge-v1-int8
```

ashwin_ml: Minimal routing policy to try (yaml for Console):
```
routing_policy:
  - condition: 'avg_latency > 400'
    route_to: rdm-large-v1
    weight: 0.6
  - condition: 'default'
    route_to: rdm-xlarge-v1
```

devin_se: +1. Also recommend adding a Dedicated burst pool for predictable peak throughput and set autoscale.min_replicas=1 for cold starts. If they want maximal savings, run int4/GPTQ in a controlled eval but only after int8 checks.

olivia_pm: I'll set up a 30m enablement session with Chloe and engineering to run quant/evals and capture quality deltas. @maria_cs can you own the follow-up and tag renewal risk in Salesforce? :calendar:

maria_cs: On it. I'll prepare a 3-point acceptance rubric: 1) top-1 token exactness drop < 2% on their eval set, 2) no new hallucination patterns in safety tests, 3) latency P95 reduced by at least 20%. Plan: run int8 + rdm-large canary this week, capture perf + cost deltas, and present to the customer.

chloe_acme: Appreciate the playbook. One more ask: add a rollback plan if customers report quality regression — procurement wants that in writing.

devin_se: Rollback plan: flip routing policy back to rdm-xlarge-v1 and disable quant flag in the model manifest; we also attach the prior model snapshot. We'll add a one-click rollback action in the Console runbook. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: canary-deploy rdm-large-v1 to customer-acme started at 1781234585 by devin_se

maria_cs: Thanks team — I'll capture notes in the CS playbook, send a short summary to Chloe, and update the renewal risk tracker. Expect initial eval results in 48-72h.
